description: One Product Trial's pool of Grove (AI) trial keys: how many stay ready, and the Grove Model Group they add to the trial team's catalog.

fields.description: How many ready keys Press keeps minted for this product's trial sites; the 5-minute job refills it. 0 keeps it off: the product's trial sites get no key.
fields.label: Pool Size

fields.description: A Grove Model Group in the trial geography, minted onto this product's keys on top of the trial team's own catalog. Blank: the team's catalog alone. Applies to keys minted after; a wrong name fails the mint, logged.
fields.label: Model Group

name: Grove Trial Product
